body:
## Summary
- SQLite data layer: one `Mutex<Connection>` in Tauri app state, idempotent schema (Appendix B), WAL + foreign_keys + `auto_vacuum INCREMENTAL`, daily backup on startup.
- Typed settings accessors over an allowlist; `daily_goal_minutes` round-trips as `i64`.
- API key stored only in OS keychain (`com.etta.app`); `test_api_key` reads the stored key (no key parameter); settings keep only `api_key_present`.
- Content cache with clean JSON payload + side-band columns (no HMAC); bad JSON = miss; 30-day TTL purge, 7-day staleness skip, keep 3 most recent per key.
- Bounded queries (every SELECT has LIMIT); xp_events pruning; pure-read `get_mastery_history` + separate `write_mastery_snapshot`.
- Input validation (concept-id `^[a-z]{2,4}_[0-9]{3}$`, lengths, ranges); structured tracing; secrets never logged.
- Conflict fixes vs prior revision: removed `hmac` crate, removed `/project` route, updated concept-id regex.
- Bare Settings form (API key, theme, daily goal) + FE IPC wrapper.

## Test plan
- [x] `cargo test --lib` (16 passed)
- [x] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` (clean)
- [x] `cargo fmt --check` (clean)
- [x] `tsc --noEmit` (pass)
- [x] `eslint` (clean)
- [x] `vitest run` (14 passed)

macOS universal binary cannot be produced in the Linux sandbox.

## Summary
Milestone 0 — foundation only. Tauri 2.x + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind (Vite) frontend, Rust backend, SQLite-ready, no server/accounts/cloud.

- HashRouter with all 7 routes (onboarding, dashboard, lesson/quiz/project/:conceptId, progress, settings) + empty placeholders
- Zustand stores as single source of truth (settings, gamification, session, curriculum)
- Shared FE/BE type contract (TS + Rust serde camelCase) with round-trip test
- Design system: Card, Button, Skeleton, Spinner, InlineError, ErrorToast; standardized labels; semantic light/dark WCAG-AA tokens; live system-theme listener
- Tauri security: locked CSP (connect-src api.anthropic.com only), withGlobalTauri:false, no macos-private-api, fs scoped to app data, no shell
- Rust crate hygiene: scoped tokio features, no doc-processing crates, xml_escape prompt-injection util
- CI gates (Makefile + npm scripts): tsc strict, eslint, cargo fmt/clippy/test, vitest — all green

Blocklist items addressed: #8, #12, #14, #18, #19, #33, #35, #48.

## Test plan
- [ ] `make ci` (all backend + frontend gates) passes
- [ ] `cargo build --bin etta` links
- [ ] `npm run build` produces the bundle
- [ ] macOS universal binary build (env-limited; documented in README — must run on macOS)
